buildCommand: npx expo export --platform web && node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const dir = 'dist/_expo/static/js/web'; if (fs.existsSync(dir)){ fs.readdirSync(dir).forEach(f => { if (f.endsWith('.js')) { const p = path.join(dir, f); fs.writeFileSync(p, fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').replace(/import\.meta\.env/g, 'undefined')); }); }"
